## Sprint 1: T-04, T-09, T-05, T-06, T-10

Stacked on PR #1 (T-02 CI). Shared Prisma schema, auth contract, web components and lockfile are kept in one integration PR so the review head remains buildable. TECH-02 server-side session + cookie was approved by the Lead on 01/10/2026 and recorded in the parent project decision log.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [x] T-04: users/roles/user_roles migration, email unique, five roles and two fake demo accounts with Argon2id.
- [x] T-09: events/showtimes migration, owner FK, deliberate RESTRICT on event deletion with showtimes, timestamptz.
- [x] T-05: web login, server-side sessions, HttpOnly/Secure cookie, Redis counter; sixth failed attempt locked for 15 minutes across app instances.
- [x] T-06: database roles evaluated per request; wrong role and undeclared route return 403, also verified with curl.
- [x] T-10: organizer-only list/create/edit/showtimes, field validation, double-submit guard and other-owner 403.
- [x] Local frozen install, Prisma validate/migrate, lint, typecheck, unit 4/4, E2E 5/5, build and desktop browser flow.
- [x] CI on this PR is green (run 36767702770, 50 seconds).
- [ ] Independent review and staging evidence before tasks move to Done.
- [x] Mobile browser verification at 390x844: login, list, create form, field errors, no horizontal overflow or console errors.

### Review focus
Migration history/compensation and data safety; auth cookie/origin, Redis lock and default deny; owner isolation; responsive and keyboard UI. Only fake local data is used. No production credential, payment, Vercel deployment or T-03 staging change.

README.md (already modified) and AGENTS.md (already untracked) were preserved outside this PR. Evidence and review handoff are in docs/SPRINT1_LOCAL_EVIDENCE.md and docs/SPRINT1_GITHUB_HANDOFF.md.
## Integration checkpoint 2026-10-05

The acceptance/evidence above describes original head 8ad585849d1b24605b3b1ba7513a1b4dfa1371d9. New head a5df54bf0a1c4f409ca05086b3455d2c4149fc71 fixes a mixed-case login regression and a baseline activation-token vulnerability discovered during technical review.

Implementation/commit/push: Codex under authorization of Nguyễn Văn Sáng, account sangnguyencoder; this is not a claim of unaided human implementation. Reviewer account per the current PO mapping: tovanquyenh-blip. Automated review is explicitly technical and does not replace the human review required by DoD.

Evidence: docs/SPRINT1_DEPENDENCY_REVIEW_FIXES.md. Clean-worktree frozen install, lint/typecheck, 4 unit tests, 11 real HTTP/database integration tests and API/web build pass. No schema/migration/UI/dependency changes in the fix; no preview database was modified. CI must be verified at the new head before merge; old-head CI is not substituted.

Still stacked on PR #1. Human review and staging acceptance remain pending; no task is marked Done. No deploy/publish/branch-protection change is authorized by this integration.

reviews.body:
Review kỹ thuật bởi Codex, đăng theo tài khoản được ủy quyền; không phải xác nhận reviewer con người đã trực tiếp đọc.
Exact revision 8ad585849d1b24605b3b1ba7513a1b4dfa1371d9 vs 32ac7268e2d5bc43be7eeeaded9d86159286e830; đã đọc toàn bộ 50 files, auth/session/roles/owner isolation, migrations, seed, UI và tests. CI revision có 6 SUCCESS, nhưng cần sửa:
P2 introduced: auth.service.ts:40/63 lowercases email khi login, users.service.ts:35 giữ email nguyên bản. Account đã kích hoạt có email Buyer@demo.invalid không login được. Lookup phải tương thích tài khoản hiện có, không hợp nhất identity; thêm regression test mixed-case.
P1 baseline carried forward: users.controller.ts activation không validate query token; users.service.ts:52 findFirst với undefined có thể bỏ filter và kích hoạt user không liên quan. Chặn token thiếu/rỗng/sai định dạng trước DB; thêm tests expired/reused/valid, không mở rộng flow đăng ký/email delivery.
Vẫn cần review con người theo DoD; không dùng approval tự động để miễn gate. Staging/migration compensation/browser là evidence riêng.

Re-review kỹ thuật tự động bởi Codex; đăng bằng tài khoản được ủy quyền, không phải xác nhận reviewer con người đã trực tiếp đọc.
Exact head: a5df54bf0a1c4f409ca05086b3455d2c4149fc71. Đã re-review full PR vs 32ac7268 và fixdiff vs 8ad5858, không còn MUST FIX đã phát hiện. Case-insensitive lookup take2 không chọn arbitrary identity; token unknown/regex ngăn filter undefined; conditional updateMany kiểm expiry và trạng thái, concurrent replay một winner. Không sửa schema/migration/roles/frontend.
Local: frozen install, lint/typecheck, unit4/4, real DB/HTTP E2E11/11, build PASS. CI mới đúng SHA: push run37224762807 SUCCESS45giây; PR run37224764663 SUCCESS49giây, ba checks mỗi run.
Request changes tại revision cũ đã được xử lý; comment này không tự dismiss hoặc thay thế review con người. Quyền cần trực tiếp kiểm source/evidence và approve head này trước merge. Dependency PR #1 chưa merge; staging/DoD còn Pending, không đánh task Done.
